summary: Officers were sent at 7:29 p.m. to a market in the 400 block of Baker Street for a report of a battery.
A 3-year-old boy was reported missing at 7:45 p.m. from a home on El Toro Drive. He was last seen in a black Lightning McQueen shirt, green cargo pants and orange and red shoes.
Officers were sent at 8:41 p.m. to check on a man whose call mentioned a firearm and who then stopped answering his phone.
A one-year-old was reported to be in and out of consciousness at 8:44 p.m., and medics were sent to the 5900 block of Wilson Road.
Officers were sent at 9:11 p.m. to a man standing in front of a bus on Stockdale Highway and refusing to move.
Medics were sent at 9:14 p.m. to the 900 block of Richmond Street for difficulty breathing.
Officers were sent at 9:16 p.m. to a park in the 500 block of Oleander Avenue for two children, seven and eight years old, reported to have said they wanted to hurt themselves.
Medics were sent at 9:50 p.m. to the 8800 block of Jerry Street for difficulty breathing.
Officers were sent at 10:44 p.m. to a weapons call after a man was reported to be holding a firearm, with people heard screaming in the background and the caller's line down.
A traffic stop over an obstructed plate turned into a pursuit at 10:47 p.m.; the car ran west and then south before two men ran off on foot, one in a tan hoodie and one in a black hoodie.
Crews were sent at 11:02 p.m. to Highway 58 and California City Boulevard for CPR in progress, and an ambulance took the patient to meet a fire crew at a station.
The CHP was called at 11:13 p.m. to a hit and run in a gas station lot off Lerdo Highway, where a white Peterbilt with a trailer hit a gold semi.

Officers were sent at 11:39 p.m. to the 600 block of Casa Loma Drive, where a man in his 30s in a red shirt and black shorts was reported to have pushed his mother and then walked toward Brundage Lane.
Fire crews were called at 11:41 p.m. to the 100 block of Washington Avenue for smoke from a laundromat and found a two-story apartment building with nothing showing and several people outside.
Officers were sent at 11:54 p.m. to a park in the 600 block of Dorrance Street for a welfare check on a man reported to be under the influence.
Officers were sent at 11:59 p.m. to the 5000 block of Pierce Road, where a caller could hear doors slamming and voices.
Medics were sent at 12:45 a.m. to the 10000 block of Old River Road for difficulty breathing.

A clerk at a store on Niles Street yelled for a man to come back at 1:11 a.m. as he ran to a waiting car carrying a box. Officers followed the car west on Niles Street, found it on Pacific Street and took one person into custody in the 900 block.
Medics were sent at 1:57 a.m. to Ming Avenue for a possible overdose; a man in his mid-40s was reported to be convulsing.
The CHP was told at 2:38 a.m. about a semi with a livestock trailer speeding on northbound Interstate 5 north of Laval Road.
Officers were sent at 3:05 a.m. to a market in the 800 block of Lincoln Street for an audible alarm with motion showing in the back of the building.
Fire crews were sent at 3:07 a.m. to a boarding care home in the 2600 block of Mount Vernon Avenue for a commercial fire alarm.
Crews were sent at 3:10 a.m. to the 6000 block of Autumn Crest Drive for a seizure.
Deputies were sent at 3:12 a.m. to a trailer park space for a man diagnosed with schizophrenia and off his medication who was reported to be in a bedroom hurting himself.

A car crossed from the southbound side of Interstate 5 into oncoming traffic near the Kern-Kings county line at 3:36 a.m. and hit a white Ford pickup head-on. The two vehicles came to rest about 200 yards apart; of four people in them, three were unhurt and one had a serious head injury. An air ambulance was asked for and then cancelled, and an ambulance took the patient.
Officers were sent at 4:04 a.m. to the 2400 block of Goldenrod Street after a resident heard someone at the front door pulling at the handle.
Medics were sent at 4:04 a.m. to the 1900 block of Clarendon Street for difficulty breathing.
Crews were sent at 4:12 a.m. to an apartment building on Verde Street for a possible stroke.
Medics were sent at 4:22 a.m. to the 5100 block of Cimarron Street for difficulty breathing.
Crews were sent at 4:26 a.m. to the 4100 block of Pinewood Lake Drive for a fall.
Officers were sent at 4:48 a.m. to the 1400 block of Lincoln Street for an open line between a man and a woman and a man in his 30s who may have been under the influence.
Officers were sent at 4:50 a.m. to a construction site where a security guard reported that two men walked onto the property and threatened to kill him.

Fire crews were sent at 4:52 a.m. to the Norris Road on-ramp to northbound Highway 99 for a semi crash with a possible gas leak, and found the rig across at least three lanes just north of the east off-ramp to Highway 58. The CHP stopped traffic while crews worked, and fire units stuck in the backup reached the scene along the shoulder.
Crews were sent at 5:12 a.m. to a building on Calloway Drive for a fall.
Medics were sent at 5:27 a.m. to the 2300 block of Pacheco Road for difficulty breathing.
Officers were sent at 5:49 a.m. to a home for a fight inside with several people. The caller said a 16-year-old had thrown things at her sister and would not say how many people were in the house.
Semi and car crash on Highway 99 near Gerard off-ramp.
Semi truck hits guardrail on Highway 99.
Two vehicles crash on northbound I-5 divider.
